verdict.rationale: Bolna documents the core of this flow. There is a REST endpoint to create agents (POST /v2/agent), an API quickstart that places a call, an official CLI that manages agents, calls and phone numbers with 'no dashboard tab required', and an official MCP server for coding agents. However, no evidence shows attaching a number to an agent through API, CLI or MCP, and the API key itself is generated by clicking a dashboard button. Provider and telephony integrations are also connected in the dashboard (Settings → Integrations), so a fully dashboard-free path is not demonstrated. missing for 10: documented API/CLI/MCP step for assigning a phone number to an agent, programmatic API-key provisioning without the dashboard, programmatic telephony/provider connection, a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (declared but 404), hands-on corroboration of the full MCP-driven flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent can provision a complete voice agent end to end — create the agent, attach a number, and place a call — through the API, CLI, or MCP without touching the dashboard
